subject: MAP: Integration Build Plan (SDK, streaming, tool-calls, structured outputs) — owners & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Johnson <sarah.johnson@acme.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: Integration Build Plan (SDK, streaming, tool-calls, structured outputs) — owners & next steps

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for the demo earlier today. Quick recap and a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) milestone focused on the integration build work we discussed. I attached a spreadsheet with a simple milestone table (20260722_MAP_Draft_Acme.xlsx).

Key proposed MAP milestone: Integration Build Plan
- SDK integration (client + server): Owner: Neha Kapoor (SE) — Target completion: 2026-08-20
  - Deliverables: sample SDK repo, quickstart guide, example auth flow
  - Dependencies: test API keys, sample data schema from your team

- Streaming & real-time behavior (prefetching, KV cache): Owner: Vivek Kulkarni (Infra) — Target completion: 2026-08-30
  - Deliverables: streaming latency tests, recommended batching settings
  - Dependencies: representative traffic pattern, test endpoints

- Tool calling / external tools integration (if required): Owner: Rafael Mendes (AE/PM) — Target: 2026-09-05
  - Deliverables: interface spec (how Redwood will call back to your tool endpoints), auth pattern, retry/circuit rules

- Structured outputs & schema mapping (JSON schema enforcement + validation): Owner: Acme engineering + Neha Kapoor — Target: 2026-08-25
  - Deliverables: structured-output schema, example mappings, validation steps

Proposed target for production launch: 2026-09-15 (subject to procurement/contract). Proposed signature target: 2026-08-15 to keep the build window consistent.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Confirm owners and dates above (or propose alternatives)
2) Provide a prioritized set of structured fields you need (sample schema or example output)
3) Redwood to share SDK sample repo + streaming test plan (Neha & Vivek)
4) Procurement timeline from your side (cc procurement if helpful)

Sarah — can you confirm if the high-level targets look reasonable? I’ll update the MAP spreadsheet and circulate a cleaned copy once we have confirmations.

Thanks,
Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198
From: Sarah Johnson <sarah.johnson@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Lee <tom.lee@acme.com>, procurement@acme.com
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Integration Build Plan (SDK, streaming, tool-calls, structured outputs) — owners & next steps

Thanks for the recap, Marissa — this is super helpful.

A few notes from our side:
- Procurement: we need the commercial terms and SOW draft for review. Procurement timeline is tight — they want any contracts routed by 2026-08-05 for our internal quarter.
- Engineering: I’m looping in Tom Lee (eng manager) so he can confirm owners and the schema work. Tom — the target production date 2026-09-15 is aggressive but possible if we start the SDK integration in the next 2–3 weeks.
- Security/compliance: we will need your SOC 2 documentation and an answer on whether any PII could be persisted in your KV cache by default.

Question on the MAP: can you call out the incremental milestones for streaming (e.g., initial POC, latency target test, rollout staging)? Also — regarding structured outputs: can Redwood enforce JSON schemas on model output and return a structured validation error if the model deviates? That's critical for our downstream parsing.

I attached our prioritized integration requirements (acme_integration_requirements.docx).

— Sarah

Subject: Re: MAP: Integration Build Plan (SDK, streaming, tool-calls, structured outputs) — owners & next steps

Sarah / Tom / procurement — great questions. Short answers and an updated breakdown below. I updated the draft MAP spreadsheet to include streaming sub-milestones and compliance artifacts (link in related_links).

Streaming sub-milestones (owner: Vivek Kulkarni)
- POC: basic streaming integration + e2e sample (Target: 2026-08-10)
- Latency test: scripted load with representative traffic + target 95th perc latency < 300ms (Target: 2026-08-20)
- Staging rollout: staged traffic + fallback policy validation (Target: 2026-08-28)

Structured outputs / schema enforcement (owner: Neha Kapoor + Acme eng)
- Redwood supports structured output constraints and can validate model output against a provided JSON schema. If the output deviates, we return a structured validation error and configurable fallback behavior (retry/relax schema / human review).
- Deliverables: example validator module, unit tests, and a sample mapping guide (Target: 2026-08-25)

Security & compliance
- SOC 2: we will share our SOC 2 type II report (P0) — Rafael will drop the doc in the drive link after I get a permission check.
- KV cache: by default we do not persist PII in the KV cache. We'll provide config knobs and a checklist for your security team to review.

Procurement note
- Rafael — can you prepare a high-level SOW + commercial summary by 2026-07-30 so procurement has something to route by 2026-08-05?

Neha & Vivek — can you confirm you can hit the dates above? Sarah / Tom — any changes to the engineering owners you want reflected in the MAP?

Thanks,
Marissa

Quick note from the SE side — we can own the SDK integration deliverables and will start with a sample repo. Planned deliverables and dates:
- Week 1 (by 2026-08-06): public sample SDK repo + quickstart (Node + Python) and auth examples
- Week 2 (by 2026-08-13): sample end-to-end integration with a small test harness your team can run against a sandbox key
- Week 4 (by 2026-08-27): full example with structured-output validation and unit tests

Dependencies from Acme:
- Provide test account and sandbox API key (or request us to provision a short-lived key)
- Example structured-output schema or sample payloads (helps prioritize mapping)

Links: sample repo (internal): https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-examples/tree/acme-map (I will copy out a minimal public quickstart into the Drive link for you)

Neha
